---
title: "Short session – the housing-audit case"
subtitle: "Two halves of about seventy-five minutes, with a facilitator"
---
The [case study](../../cases/housing/index.qmd), which presents the original study, the Multi100 project, the five reanalyses and the SCORE replication on which both tracks of the case are built, is the place to start.

This is the short session on the housing-audit case, for a slot of two to three hours. It works on the same field experiment and the same claim as the [one-day course](../housing-one-day/index.qmd), with less of the background. The session covers the vocabulary of reproduction, robustness and replication, the claim of the original authors (OAs) and the estimand statement behind it, the reproduction of a value that Multi100 recorded for one of five analysts, a first exploration of the menu of defensible analyses, and the replication that tested the claim with new data. You leave with a reproduced result, an estimand statement, and an exploratory mark of your own on the class chart, placed among the 64 specifications on the curve of the claim. The preregistration of Task 5 is left for afterwards, in the workspace.

The session runs as two halves of about seventy-five minutes with a break of fifteen minutes between them. The class reproduces the result together and sends its values at the same moment, so the session needs a facilitator. There is no time in the session for mending an installation, which is why the setup comes before it.

| | What happens | Length |
|---|---|---|
| [Before the session](before.qmd) | Install R and an IDE (Positron, RStudio, VS Code, etc.), download the workspace, run the setup check, read the case study. | 1 to 2 hours, once |
| [First half – The claim and its reproduction](half-1.qmd) | The three Rs and the SCORE programme, the paper and the five analysts, the estimand statement and the causal graph; then you reproduce the recorded result. | about 75 minutes |
| [Second half – Exploration and replication](half-2.qmd) | The specification menu, from which you put an exploratory mark on the class chart; the class reads its chart against the curve of 64, and meets the replication with new data. | about 75 minutes |
| [After the session](after.qmd) | Task 5 in the workspace, and where to go next. | as you like |
